title: Component Part 2.1: AS2 class-emission infra — functional mx.controls.Button (self-authored, no Halo skin)
description: Build on Part 1 (task 1229, commit 9fba499) which emits per placed component a placeholder DefineSprite + ExportAssets(mx.controls.*) + DoInitAction Object.registerClass. PART 2.1 (the load-bearing infra slice; per the decomposition plan): make ONE component genuinely render+react in Ruffle using AS2 WE generate — NOT the real Adobe mx.* framework, NO Halo skin asset. Steps: (1) Add a raw-bytecode DoInitAction variant in packages/swf/src/doInitAction.ts (current encodeDoInitAction only builds registerClass). (2) In packages/swf/src/compiler/components.ts: author a FLAT self-contained AS2 class string for mx.controls.Button (constructor + setLabel + onRelease/onRollOver dispatch; no extends chain — the AS2 compiler compileAS2() from @flash/core, already a dep, handles flat classes/methods/this-member per compiler.ts compileClassDecl), compile it with compileAS2, and emit it as a DoInitAction BEFORE the registerClass DoInitAction (ordering controlled by push order in runComponentPass) so the constructor exists when registerClass binds it. (3) Replace encodeEmptyDefineSprite with a real skin: a DefineShape4 filled rounded rect sized to the component default width/height + a named DefineEditText ('label_txt') inside the sprite timeline via PlaceObject2 (helpers exist in shapes.ts / text path / sprite.ts). (4) Param: simplest — statically seed the author's label into the EditText initial text at compile time (live param-passing is a follow-on). VERIFY (no real-Flash fixture needed): unit test (extend component-place.test.ts) decodes our own SWF and asserts the class DoInitAction contains DefineFunction2 (0x8e) and is ordered before registerClass, and the DefineSprite contains a DefineShape4 + EditText; PLUS a Ruffle visual oracle (apps/desktop/e2e, screenshotStage) asserting the button renders non-blank button-shaped pixels, and an interactivity/clip-event check that the class instance is live (use onClipEvent(load)/enterFrame, not headless mouseDown). KEY UNKNOWN to resolve: does Ruffle bind a DoInitAction-defined class via registerClass to the exported placeholder sprite at runtime — the oracle proves/disproves this. OUT OF SCOPE: full mx.* framework, Halo skins, other controls (CheckBox/List/etc. are later waves). Scope files: packages/swf/src/compiler/components.ts, doInitAction.ts, shapes.ts (reuse), component-place.test.ts, new e2e spec. Build+tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixture failures acceptable); update docs/13.
